fact: Decree 2020-146/PR/MI, applying law 39/AN/19/8eme L of 21 January 2019, makes public, parapublic and private bodies holding data on natural persons obliged to communicate it to the DGPF for the national population register, with ANSIE securing the exchanges.
title: Decret n 2020-146/PR/MI portant modalites d'acces, d'Exploitation et de Communication du Registre National des Personnes Physiques
